metadata.note: Normalized OpenZFS model. Custom effect.zfs traits are consumed by effect-zfs codegen.

effect.zfs#zfsProperty.name: checksum
effect.zfs#zfsProperty.valuesText: on | off | fletcher2 | fletcher4 | sha256 | sha512 | skein | edonr | blake3

effect.zfs#zfsProperty.name: dedup
effect.zfs#zfsProperty.valuesText: on | off | verify | sha256[,verify] | sha512[,verify] | skein[,verify] | edonr,verify | blake3[,verify]

effect.zfs#zfsProperty.name: encryption
effect.zfs#zfsProperty.valuesText: on | off | aes-128-ccm | aes-192-ccm | aes-256-ccm | aes-128-gcm | aes-192-gcm | aes-256-gcm
